name: Wall Calf Stretch

instructions.description: Place both hands on a wall and step one foot back.
Keep the back heel down and toes facing forward.
Bend the front knee and lean forward gently.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the time performed with comfortable, controlled technique.
Use a consistent reviewer-defined quality scale for control and alignment.

variations.variationDescription: Wall Calf Stretch — Supported Mobility Version: Add stable support or cushions to reduce balance or floor-access demands.

commentsNotes: Keep the back heel comfortably grounded.
